title.full: Monthly payout after topping up ERS

summary.text: The payout depends on your age when you set aside the ERS and when you start receiving payouts.

details.heading: If you are 55 in 2026
details.body: The illustrative monthly payout is $3,200–$3,400 from age 65.

details.heading: If you are 65 in 2026
details.body: If you set aside your Full Retirement Sum at age 55 and top up to ERS in 2026, the illustrative monthly payout is $2,600–$2,800.

example_phrasings: How much CPF monthly payout can I receive if I top up to the raised Enhanced Retirement Sum in 2026?
How much will I get each month from CPF LIFE?
What payout can I get after topping up to the ERS?

sources.page_title: How much CPF monthly payout can I receive if I top up to the raised Enhanced Retirement Sum in 2026?

quotes.text: Your CPF monthly payout depends on several factors, including the age when you set aside the Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS) and when you start receiving payouts.
Age 55 in 2026 and top up to ERS in 2026 $3,200 – $3,400 from age 65
Age 65 in 2026, set aside your Full Retirement Sum at age 55 and top up to ERS in 2026 $2,600 – $2,800
